name: billing-settings
title: Billing settings
description: A SaaS billing page inside the app: the plan, the card on file with its health, billing details edited in place, an invoice table, and a payment methods dialog with card slots, a backup card, add and edit in the slot, undo, and wallets.

useCases: Billing pages for SaaS and AI apps on a subscription
Managing saved cards, a backup card and wallets in one place
Account pages with invoices and billing details
Admin dashboards with a sidebar and a settings area

a11y.reducedMotion: Nothing slides, scales or blurs: amounts appear without rolling, panels and cards only fade, the dialog's height changes at once, removed cards fade out instead of shrinking, and spinners hold still.

keyboard.action: Moves through the sidebar, the plan and payment method links, Edit on billing details, each invoice download, and every control in the dialog
Opens the payment methods dialog, picks a method tab, makes a card the default, retries or updates a card, adds, edits or removes a card, or connects a wallet
Moves between the Cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay tabs
Moves the default between saved cards that can be charged
Closes the dialog without saving; focus returns to Manage payment methods

notes: Opening the dialog puts focus on the method tabs; closing it returns focus to the link that opened it.

Saved cards are a radio group: each card's name says its number, its health (“Declined on Nov 1”, “Expired 10/26”) and whether it is the default or the backup. Expired cards can't be chosen and say so.

Removing a card shows an Undo toast that is a polite live region and says what changed; its timer pauses while the pointer or focus is on it. The default card's remove button is disabled with the reason in a tooltip.
Every field in the add, edit and billing forms has a visible label; errors sit under the field, are linked with `aria-describedby`, and clear as soon as the field is edited.
Status is never colour alone: pills and health lines carry the word (Active, Paid, Expiring, Payment failed), and icon-only buttons are named (“Download invoice #1042”, “Edit Visa ending 4242”).
gaps: Card brand logos (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) are drawn as images with a name; a brand with no logo here shows as Visa until you add its mark. (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content)
